issue.title: Split Radius and Spacing into a Geometry tab
issue.description:
Reorganize the Workbench top-level control tabs so Radius and Spacing move into a dedicated Geometry tab, while Shadow and Motion remain under Effects.

Owner direction:

* Add a new top-level tab named "Geometry".
* Move Radius controls into Geometry.
* Move Spacing controls into Geometry.
* Leave Shadow under Effects.
* Leave Motion under Effects.

Target top-level tab order:

Colors
Typography
Geometry
Effects
Command

Target grouping:

Geometry

* Radius
* Spacing

Effects

* Shadow
* Motion

Rationale:
Radius and Spacing define the UI's structural shape and spatial system, while Shadow and Motion are better understood as visual/behavioral effects. The new grouping should make the Workbench information architecture clearer and more semantically coherent.

Preserve:

* existing Radius control behavior and values;
* existing Spacing control behavior and values;
* existing Shadow control behavior and values;
* existing Motion control behavior and values;
* current tab styling;
* current active/inactive tab treatment;
* keyboard navigation and focus behavior;
* theme persistence/import/export;
* Design Command behavior;
* semantic token architecture.

Implementation preference:

* Reuse the existing top-level Tabs implementation and shared tab styling.
* Do not create a second/custom tab pattern.
* Keep the change focused on information architecture and control placement.
* If internal section keys currently use "effects" for Radius/Spacing, update only what is necessary to support the new Geometry grouping cleanly.

Do not:

* change token names or schema;
* change Radius/Spacing/Shadow/Motion semantics;
* add new token controls in this ticket;
* redesign the control UI;
* change control spacing/typography beyond what is necessary to accommodate the new tab;
* change unrelated tabs.

Acceptance:

* A new "Geometry" tab appears between Typography and Effects.
* Radius is available only under Geometry.
* Spacing is available only under Geometry.
* Shadow remains under Effects.
* Motion remains under Effects.
* Top-level tab order is Colors / Typography / Geometry / Effects / Command.
* Existing control values and behavior remain unchanged.
* Keyboard/focus/tab semantics remain correct.
* No regression to persistence, import/export, history, Design Command, or theme rendering.
